}}'''Lian''' is the [[Roofmistress]] of [[Cold Rocks Hold]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Lian|Lian}} She is of the [[Nine Valleys]] [[Sept]] of the [[Taardad]] [[Aiel]].{{ref||Lian}}

== Appearance ==
Lian is slender and beautiful, with yellow hair graying slightly at the temples, and gray eyes. She appears older than her sister-wife Amys since Amys can channel.

== Family affiliations ==
Lian is wife to [[Rhuarc]], [[sister-wife]] to [[Amys]] and [[sister-mother]] to [[Aviendha]].{{ref/book|4|12}}

==Activities==
She greets Rhuarc, [[Heirn]] and [[Rand]] when they arrive at Cold Rocks Hold from Rhuidean. When [[Couladin]] acts as a clan chief, she responds as if he is a beggar.{{ref/book|4|49}}
